driverInstallation.windows10: Recommended: Install HP Smart app from Microsoft Store for best experience with HP+ features. Search 'HP Smart' in Microsoft Store, install, and follow guided setup. Alternative: Download driver from hp.com/support, search 'OfficeJet Pro 9025e', select Windows 10, run installer. Driver includes full feature software with scan, fax, and shortcut capabilities. HP Smart required for Smart Tasks and mobile features.
driverInstallation.windows11: Same as Windows 10. HP Smart app fully supports Windows 11 and ARM64 processors. Download from Microsoft Store or hp.com/support. Windows 11 may auto-discover via WSD but HP Smart recommended for HP+ benefits, cloud printing, mobile scan, and smart workflow automation.
driverInstallation.mac: Recommended: Install HP Smart from Mac App Store for full HP+ integration. Compatible with macOS 11+ and Apple Silicon. Automatically discovers OfficeJet on network. Alternative: Add via System Settings > Printers & Scanners, select 'HP OfficeJet Pro 9025e', download software when prompted. Supports native AirPrint for basic printing. HP Smart required for scanning, faxing, shortcuts, and mobile features.
driverInstallation.linux: Install HPLIP 3.21.6 or later from hplip.sourceforge.net or via package manager (apt/dnf). For Ubuntu: 'sudo apt install hplip hplip-gui python3-pyqt5'. Run 'hp-setup' for guided configuration or 'hp-setup -i' for interactive mode. Select network discovery or enter IP manually. Install plugin if prompted (required for some features). Basic printing, scanning, and duplex supported. Advanced HP+ features not available on Linux.
